provenance.client_tables: 2019 CondaRO client data.grf: skilleffectinfolist.lub (SKILL_EFFECT_INFO_LIST), skillid.lub, effectid.lub
provenance.method: CGameMode::ReceiveSkillUse / CSession::PlaySkillEffect effect ids; effect implementations from CRagEffect/CEffect; primitives mapped to korangar layer kinds; lifetimes in frames at 60 fps
provenance.note: Rows marked mode=append only add the official layers the committed descriptor was missing (the existing, tuned layers are kept); other rows are new descriptors for skills that had none. Only skills where the decompiled C++ and the roBrowser-derived effect table agree on the effect id are included. Effect lifetimes are frames at 60 fps, clamped to the layer schema maximum of 30000 ms.
